excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content:
we want the versioned hash construction in any case as it is likely the commitment scheme will change over time

this EIP is much simpler to ship if it is one thing to add to the EVM-level, rather than a set of precompiles like EIP-2537 so that would be the preferred path all other things being equal

i will separately bring up the bls precompiles on ACDs to see what appetite there is

excerpts.author: kanagwa
excerpts.content:
Hi I have a few open questions related to 4844. I decided to ask here, let me know if it's not the right place:

- What it means `seeding the DHT`? In the context of 4844 Gossip.
- What are the rows/columns comparison with blobs? Also mentioned in some documents like `full danksharding row/column dissemination`.
- What’s the difference of push vs poll on distribution of blobs. In the context of Gossip.
- What’s the `forkchoice store`?
